title: Coastal Retreat House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Situated in the heart of a beloved resort community, our vacation home offers a prime central location. Immerse yourself in the tranquil ambiance of the area, with four swimming pools, a beach club, and tennis and basketball courts all at your fingertips. The Dragonfly pool, located just around the corner, provides convenient leisure opportunities, while the renowned WaterColor Beach Club is a short mile and a half west. Explore the nearby Scenic Highway 30A, adorned with charming cafes, picturesque beach access points, and the scenic 18.5-mile Timpoochee Trail. Within a stone's throw, you'll discover the majestic Grayton Beach State Park, boasting one of the area's most stunning coastlines. Nature enthusiasts will also appreciate the proximity of Point Washington State Forest, less than a mile away, as well as the vibrant town of Seaside, just a mile and a half away. For further beach adventures, Thomas Pilcher Park and Blue Mountain Beach are within a 10-mile radius, while Topsail Hill Preserve State Park Gregory E. Moore RV Resort, 30 Avenue, and Camp Helen State Park can all be reached within 15 miles. And for those seeking to perfect their swing, the Windswept Dunes Golf Club is located approximately 20 miles away.
